王野下午回了办公室，看见所有人都在，王野打过招呼直接回了自己的办公桌，刚坐下，石磊就凑了过来：“小野，我听见咱打的那个姓贾的说要报复你。”

石磊说完，办公室的人立刻全都围了过来，没等王野问话，孙叔先开口了：“石头，你听谁说的，靠谱吗？”

石磊：“孙叔，我也是刚才刷饭盒时，听见姓贾的和别人说的。”

王野说：“石头哥，那小子是怎么说的？”

石磊想了一下，说：“他说找了人，今天下班回去的路上打断你一条腿。”

孙叔：“小野，没事儿，下班了咱一起走，几个小混混掀不起浪来。”

冯大力：“小野，没事儿啊！你大力哥在部队里的时候，格斗全连都能排上号，来个三五个，你大力哥自己一个人就够了。”

张勇：“算我一个，我虽然不如大力哥，对付三两个还是没问题的！”

方平赶紧说：“还有我！”

石磊怯生生的说：“我，我也去。”

王野心想：“这一屋子同事是真不错，就连石磊都要帮忙。”

王野知道石磊生性胆小，从贾东旭踢他一脚都没还手就看得出来。

王野说：“那就先谢谢各位叔叔哥哥了！不论有没有事儿，今天晚上咱必须吃一顿，正好一起走，咱直接去东来顺。”王野也没有说自己武力值怎么怎么高，这都是人家的好意，这要是拒绝那就有点给脸不要脸了。

孙叔说：“小野，吃饭就算了。”

王野打断孙叔接下来的话，说：“孙叔，咱以后时间长着呢，就当是联络感情了吗！男人嘛！联络感情最快的方法不就是一起喝点吗！”

孙叔：“你个小屁孩！还男人。”

王野：“孙叔，在我们老家16的都娶媳妇了，我可不小了~”

冯大力插了句话：“那小不小的咱也没见呀！”

王野听见冯大力居然敢开车，那能怂吗？想当初自己可是老司机的，会开不过他？

“大力哥，不服咱清华池走一趟，到时候咱比比。”

“比就比，谁怕谁啊？”

众人越听越觉得不对，赶紧各回各的位子上了，孙叔心想：“这帮小兔崽子可以不要脸，我踏马这么大岁数了，要是也被卷进这场比试，老脸都得丢没。”整整一下午就在愉快的氛围中结束了。

下了班，王野跟王铁柱说了今天要和同事要去吃饭，就不和他们一起走了，半小时后没有人出门后，巡逻队也过来接班了，一行人浩浩荡荡的奔向东来顺。

孙叔：“小野，如果一会儿真有人找事儿，动手可以不能下死手，也不能动枪，咱的枪在工厂里好使，出了工厂不到万不得已不要动，要不然性质就变了。”

王野说：“孙叔放心吧！就贾东旭那货也不会认识什么上的了台面的人物，咱还不至于动枪。”

孙叔又对冯大力和张勇说：“大力和小勇，一会儿要有事儿护着点小野和石头。”

冯大力：“孙叔放心吧！我你还信不过吗？”

孙叔笑骂道：“就是信不过你，一打架就上头，主要是你不许下死手。”

Wang Ye returned to the office in the afternoon and saw everyone there. Wang Ye said hello and went directly back to his desk. As soon as he sat down, Shi Lei came over and said, "Xiao Ye, I heard that the person named Jia we beat said he wanted to take revenge on you."

After Shi Lei finished speaking, everyone in the office immediately gathered around him. Before Wang Ye could ask questions, Uncle Sun spoke first: "Shitou, who did you listen to? Is it reliable?"

Shi Lei: "Uncle Sun, I heard what Jia said to others when I was cleaning the lunch box just now."

Wang Ye said: "Brother Shitou, what did that kid say?"

Shi Lei thought for a moment and said, "He said he found someone to break your leg on the way back from get off work today."

Uncle Sun: "Xiaoye, it's okay. Let's go together after get off work. A few gangsters can't make waves."

Feng Dali: "Xiaoye, it's okay! When your brother Dali was in the army, the entire fighting company could be ranked. If there are only three or five, you, Dali, can do it by yourself."

Zhang Yong: "Count me in. Even though I'm not as good as Dali, I can still handle three or two with no problem!"

Fang Ping quickly said: "And me!"

Shi Lei timidly said: "I, I will go too."

Wang Ye thought: "There are really good colleagues in this room, even Shi Lei wants to help."

Wang Ye knew that Shi Lei was timid by nature, which was evident from the fact that Jia Dongxu didn't even fight back when he kicked him.

Wang Ye said: "Then thank you uncles and brothers first! Regardless of whether there is anything or not, we have to have a meal tonight, and we happen to be leaving together. Let's go directly to Donglaishun." Wang Ye did not say how high his martial arts value was. This was all people's good intentions. It would be a bit shameless to refuse.

Uncle Sun said: "Xiaoye, forget about eating."

Wang Ye interrupted Uncle Sun's next words and said: "Uncle Sun, we have a lot of time in the future, so let's just think of it as a way to connect with each other! Men! The fastest way to connect with each other is to have a drink together!"

Uncle Sun: "You little brat! Still a man."

Wang Ye: "Uncle Sun, all the 16-year-olds in our hometown are married. I'm not young~"

Feng Dali interrupted: "We haven't seen that little one either!"

Wang Ye heard that Feng Dali dared to drive. Can he be scared?Thinking that I was an experienced driver back then, how could I not drive him?

"Brother Dali, if you don't agree with me, let's go to Tsinghua Lake. Then we'll compete."

“It’s a competition, who’s afraid of whom?”

The more everyone listened, the more they felt something was wrong, and hurriedly went back to their seats. Uncle Sun thought to himself: "These little bastards can be shameless. I am as old as I am, and if I am involved in this competition, I will lose my face." The whole afternoon ended in a happy atmosphere.

After work, Wang Ye told Wang Tiezhu that he was going to eat with his colleagues today, so he stopped leaving with them. After half an hour, when no one went out, the patrol team also came to take over, and the group rushed towards Dong Laishun.

Uncle Sun: "Xiaoye, if someone is really looking for trouble soon, you don't have to use a deadly blow, and you can't use a gun. Our guns are easy to use in the factory. Don't use them outside the factory unless you have to, otherwise the nature will change."

Wang Ye said: "Uncle Sun, don't worry! Even Jia Dongxu doesn't know anyone on the stage, so we won't take action yet."

Uncle Sun said to Feng Dali and Zhang Yong again: "Dali and Xiaoyong, we have to protect Xiaoye and Shitou soon."

Feng Dali: "Uncle Sun, don't worry! Don't you still believe me?"

Uncle Sun smiled and scolded: "I just can't trust you. You always get involved in a fight. The main reason is that you are not allowed to kill me."
